drhp.business: Avience Biomedicals Limited, established in 2019, is a medical-consumable company that manufactures in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) products and medical devices from its facility in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Its range spans IVD rapid test kits (VTM, Covid, HIV, HBsAg, Malaria, Dengue and others), serology products, biochemistry analysers, biochemistry reagents and culture media. It sells B2B, B2C and B2G to pathology/microbiology labs, hospitals and research centres nationwide and to export markets, and also acts as a distributor/trader of medical equipment.

business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Mixed manufacturing-plus-distribution model. Forward: acts as distributor/trader of medical equipment and is an authorised channel partner of Mindray Medical India Private Limited, trading branded IVD equipment and reagents sold under original brand names; sells across B2B, B2C and B2G channels to pathology/microbiology labs, hospitals and research centres domestically and via exports. Backward: manufactures its own IVD consumables (rapid test kits, molecular PCR kits, culture media, biochemistry/electrolyte reagents and analysers) in-house under the 'Avienbio' brand; DRHP states higher in-house manufacturing reduced dependence on third-party suppliers for certain products (direct costs fell from 65.05% of revenue in FY2023-24 to 59.83% in FY2024-25). Purchases and sales of traded goods are significantly transacted with wholly owned subsidiary DR Meditech Surgical and Diagnostics Private Limited. Raw materials are heavily sourced from a concentrated supplier base (imported monoclonal/recombinant antigens from FAPON among key inputs); no long-term or exclusive supply contracts, with orders placed on a requirement basis.

overview.business_model: The Company manufactures IVD rapid test kits (VTM, Covid, HIV, HBs AG, Malaria, Dengue and others) and a range of medical devices such as serology products, biochemistry analysers and biochemistry reagents, and also acts as a distributor and trader of medical equipment. genesis.founding_story: Established in 2019 amidst the global challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic, and recognized as a Startup and a Small-scale Industry under MSME. The Company commenced its journey by producing essential diagnostic kits like Viral Transport Media (VTM), Covid, HIV, HBs AG, Malaria, Dengue and others, aimed at aiding medical institutions with affordable and good-quality solutions, and later expanded from IVD rapid test kits into serology products, biochemistry analysers and biochemistry reagents.

internal_operational.detail: A substantial portion of total revenue comes from a limited set of customers; loss of, or reduced business from, major customers could materially affect business, financial condition and cash flows. Names not disclosed for confidentiality.

internal_operational.detail: Relies on suppliers for medical equipment, surgical instruments, consumables, laboratory reagents and diagnostic equipment with no long-term or exclusive supply agreements; orders placed on requirement basis. Faced disruption during COVID.
internal_operational.title: Reliance on suppliers for traded goods and raw materials (RF 3)

internal_operational.detail: A significant portion of revenue is derived from trading activities; instability in this segment could adversely impact overall performance. Company states it is pursuing diversification.
internal_operational.evidence: Trading revenue: 1,967.27 lakhs (68.44%) period ended 31-Jan-2026, 2,089.06 (72.31%) FY25, 1,293.84 (79.60%) FY24, 915.29 (83.81%) FY23. Manufacturing: 30.70%/27.32%/20.40%/16.19%. Total revenue from operations 2,874.64 lakhs (Jan-26).
internal_operational.title: Significant revenue dependence on trading segment (RF 5)

internal_operational.detail: Orders may be delayed, modified, cancelled or not fully paid; deliveries may lead to postponed or refused payment or counterparty default.
internal_operational.evidence: As of January 31, 2026 trade receivables stood at Rs. 1,163.74 Lakhs.
internal_operational.title: Customer order delays, modifications, cancellations or non-payment (RF 7)

internal_operational.detail: Business depends on the manufacturing unit at G-1, Sector-11, Noida; past machinery breakdowns; operating risks include equipment failure, accidents, natural disasters. Some events may not be fully covered by insurance.
internal_operational.evidence: Manufacturing unit located at G-1, Sector-11, Noida, Distt.- Gautam Budh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh.
internal_operational.title: Dependence on efficient functioning of manufacturing and assembly facilities; machinery breakdowns (RF 9)

internal_operational.detail: A portion of raw materials is sourced from China; restrictions, trade-policy changes, higher import duties, customs delays or geo-political developments may affect availability and cost.
internal_operational.evidence: China constituted 5.18% (FY 2022-23), 31.33% (FY 2023-24), 22.47% (FY 2024-25) and 2.99% (period ended January 31, 2026) of total raw material procurement.
internal_operational.title: Import of raw materials from China; import restrictions/duties (RF 10)

strategy_growth.detail: Company has undertaken material acquisitions; no assurance the expected strategic and financial benefits (integration, synergies) will materialize; underperformance could lead to impairment losses.
strategy_growth.evidence: Acquisition of DR Meditech Surgical and Diagnostics (India) Private Limited through a Share Purchase Agreement dated August 08, 2023.
strategy_growth.title: Material acquisitions may not yield intended benefits (RF 17)

strategy_growth.detail: A small portion of business comes from Central/State government contracts allocated via competitive tenders; reduction in budgetary allocations, policy changes or shift in outsourcing could reduce opportunities.
strategy_growth.evidence: Company states it is not significantly dependent on Government contracts.
strategy_growth.title: Dependence on government tender-based opportunities (RF 18)

strategy_growth.detail: Significant revenue from existing product lines and service relationships; growth depends on successful development, introduction and market acceptance of new products, services and innovations.
strategy_growth.title: Revenue dependent on existing product lines and market acceptance of new products (RF 31)

strategy_growth.detail: Expansion involving installation of additional plant and machinery and building construction is subject to unanticipated delays and cost overruns due to labour shortages, regulatory restrictions and other factors.
strategy_growth.evidence: Planned new manufacturing unit at industrial plot no. 70, Sector 28, Medical Device Park under YEIDA, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh.
strategy_growth.title: Expansion plan – delays and cost overruns (RF 38)

strategy_growth.detail: Success depends on commercializing new medical products requiring development, testing and regulatory approvals; products under development may not perform, gain timely approval, or achieve market acceptance, and may face IP litigation.
strategy_growth.title: Commercialized products may not perform as expected (RF 39)

strategy_growth.detail: Competitiveness depends on continuous innovation; failure or delay in developing/launching new products or keeping pace with competitors' technologies could weaken competitive edge and render existing products obsolete.
strategy_growth.title: Challenges/delays in innovation and new product development (RF 41)

drhp.strategies: Expand manufacturing capacity and diversify the product range|Set up a new manufacturing unit at the Medical Device Park, YEIDA|Broaden the geographic footprint, including exports to African and other overseas markets|Continue adding manufacturing licenses for new IVD products, reagents and analysers
drhp.strengths: Diversified IVD and medical-device product portfolio built through a rapidly expanding set of manufacturing licenses|Multiple quality accreditations (ISO 9001:2016, ISO 13485, WHO GMP, ZED MSME Gold, CDSCO compliance)|In-house manufacturing capability across rapid tests, reagents, culture media and analysers|Promoter-led leadership with 30 years of industry experience|Established B2B, B2C and B2G channels across North India plus a growing export presence
